# Analysis recipes

These short recipes capture a few of the most common analysis workflows in Soundscapy. They are intended to be read alongside the main tutorials rather than as a substitute for them.

## Typical workflows

- **Compare two or more locations** — use the same data preparation steps as the survey tutorial and then create a multi-location comparison.
- **Inspect a distribution of responses** — start from a single location and use a density or joint plot to look at concentration and spread.
- **Work with SPI-style comparisons** — use the SPI tutorial when you want a formal comparison between distributions rather than a simple visual check.
- **Build an end-to-end workflow** — follow the full applied tutorial once you are comfortable with the basics.

Useful companion pages include [Working with survey data](13-working-with-survey-data.qmd), [Understanding the Soundscape Perception Index](15-understanding-spi.qmd), and [How to analyse and represent soundscape perception](18-how-to-analyse-and-represent-soundscapes.qmd).
